scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./lib/api-client-react" --filter "./api-server" --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.railway:build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @workspace/soccer-dashboard run build && pnpm --filter soccer-ai-predictor-api-bundled run build
